verdict.rationale: Working Copy's docs show it connects to remotes over SSH. It supports the ssh protocol for Git, keys that can be imported or generated in-app and attached to an Identity, and Secure Enclave-held keys protected by Face ID or Touch ID. It can also run SSH commands against Linux, BSD or Synology servers to list repositories. However, this SSH use is scoped to Git hosting, and the docs never name the supported key algorithms. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA key support, evidence of general-purpose SSH connections to remote servers beyond Git operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
